title: E-Ink for Productivity: An Introduction
summary: Technology Connections gives first impressions of using an Onyx Boox Max2 e-ink tablet for productivity, including using it as an external display. He shows what the device can and cannot do.
why: HN recommends it, with its companion video, as an honest hands-on account of e-ink devices as monitors, including their slow software and limits.

quote.text: Technology Connections on youtube tried to use an eink display and thoroughly described his experiences.
